title: Audit-ready retention timelines and anonymized export for prompts, responses, logs, and metrics
creator: Asha Patel
description: Goal: Provide tenants with configurable, auditable retention timelines that (1) automatically apply anonymization transforms to prompts/responses when required by policy, (2) tier request-log and metrics retention with compacted time-series for long-term storage, and (3) produce time-bound, signed evidence bundles for audits and legal requests. Scope includes API/Console controls for per-tenant and per-route TTLs, a background decay worker for automated anonymization prior to archival, and an evidence export runner that can produce SHA256-attested bundles with residency metadata. This is specifically focused on retention behavior for interactive request artifacts (prompts + responses), request logs, and derived metrics/telemetry. Out of scope for this ticket: long-term cold-storage archival pipelines and deep forensic tooling (handled in follow-ups).
acceptance_criteria: 1) Console: tenant admin can set per-route and inherited default TTLs for prompts/responses/logs/metrics and see effective residency and estimated storage delta; 2) API: new /retention endpoints that return computed TTL and residency for a route and accept patch to update TTL templates; 3) Anonymization worker: records show prompt text transformed to pseudonymized form before moving to archived tier for tenants with anonymization policy; 4) Evidence export: one-click export generates a signed ZIP with sample manifests, residency tags, and checksums; 5) Tests: unit + e2e cover TTL inheritance, anonymization toggles, and export integrity; 6) Documentation: PRD + Console help copy and API spec published in Confluence and developer docs.
implementation_notes: - TTL model: three layers (route override > tenant template > org default). - Two retention tiers: hot (raw, live) and compacted archive (anonymized/pseudonymized). - Anonymization rules: remove PII heuristics, hash stable IDs, and optionally mask substrings via tenant policy. - Evidence export runner will call export-service (ENG-33782) and attach residency labels and HMAC of bundle using KMS key per-tenant. - UI surfaces: route settings modal, tenant-level retention dashboard, and an export audit activity card. - Backfill plan: phased backfilling for existing data over a rolling 3-week window to avoid throughput spikes.
risks_and_mitigation:
Risk: accidental data loss if anonymization rules are too aggressive. Mitigation: ship anonymization as non-destructive transform on archive copy for first release (keep raw in hot tier for 14 days), add rollback tooling and test harness with synthetic workloads.
Risk: evidence export performance under heavy audit loads. Mitigation: rate-limit exports per-tenant and provide async job interface with progress dashboard.
Risk: regulatory divergence across regions. Mitigation: per-tenant residency flags and validation to prevent exports that violate residency constraints.
